- The file-tree preview needs no extra plugin: it regist"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ers a tab type on DSH's right sidebar and claims `dsh-resource://file/**` addresses ending in `.univ"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"er`. While `dsh-better-sidebar` (`^0.19.0`) is installed it takes over file addresses at the same pr"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"iority with a broader pattern, so the preview is registered as one of its file viewers instead — bot"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"h shapes are covered, and only one ever applies.
- Older `.univer` files are automatically upgraded "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"to format v3 when opened. A backup is saved beside the original; migration and validation run on a t"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"emporary copy, which replaces the original only after success. -"},{"id":"p19s9","text":" Screenshots, PDF printing, Slide layout checks, and SVG text measurement need a local Chromium-fami"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"ly browser. - Slide master pages, layout pages, and speaker notes are outside the"},{"id":"p19s13","text":" current editing scope.
- Board mind maps, tables, ink, advanced editing, and file export are not ye"},{"id":"p19s14","text":"t supported.
